correctness.rationale: Definitions and six pairwise-disjoint cases reconstructed for every positive number of leaves. Every inverse image of a target singleton or edge is checked by center-fiber combinatorics; converse constructions satisfy the same face conditions. The six contributions are the two appropriate partial-injection polynomials with center shifts, one shifted smaller injection polynomial, and three elementary singleton or doubleton terms, explicitly stated in RESULT.md. Partial injection counts are binomial choices times permutations. Equality of complete coefficient dictionaries was independently checked by exhaustively enumerating every partial function on each of the first five stars using packaged verify.py. The infinite claim follows only from the general case classification, not finite experiments.

value.rationale: Stars form the canonical unbounded-valence trees complementary to the paths and cycles targeted in current work on Margolis–Rhodes graph monoids. Exact rank-domain coefficients for the whole infinite family are natural semigroup invariants, finer than order, and can inform future rank-stratum, regularity and probability questions. The formula is proved for every positive leaf count by a center-fiber classification; it is neither an unmotivated finite census nor a cosmetic restatement of the earlier general structural lemma.
